senses.gloss: (v. זוּף a. זֶפֶת), Pi. זִיפֵּף to line vessels with pitch.—Part. pass. Kal זָפוּף, Part. Pual מְזוּפָּף.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 4:10">Tosef. Ab. Zar. IV</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 5:10">V</cite>), 10 <he>זְפוּפוֹת</he>; <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 33a:7">Ab. Zar. 33ᵃ</cite> <he>מְזוּפָּפִין</he>.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 40b">B. Mets. 40ᵇ</cite> <he>במז׳</he> when the oil vessels are lined. V. <he>זָפַת</he>.
